latvia.title: POSTIMEES UKRAINAS ⟩ «Võtsin turvavöö lahti, tegin aknad lahti ja olin valmis autost välja hüppama.» Kes ja miks ostab eluaseme Venemaa piiri ääres
latvia.description: Täiemahulise sõja aastatega on Ukraina eluasemeturg põhjalikult muutunud. Peale eluaseme suuruse ja maja kvaliteedi arvestavad ostjad nüüd ka sellega, millisest suunast võivad tulla Venemaa rünnakud, kui kaugel on Venemaa piir, kas elektrikatkestuste ajal liftid töötavad, kas majas on gaas ning mis asub maja läheduses.

latvia.title: Kosi sõnul jälgib EL Ukraina edusamme reformide elluviimisel
latvia.description: Euroopa Liit (EL) jälgib pingsalt Ukraina Ülemraada tööd ja eriti rahvusvähemusi puudutavate õigusaktide oodatud muudatuste vastuvõtmist, ütles esmaspäeval ühenduse laienemisvolinik Marta Kos, kelle sõnu vahendas uudisteagentuur Ukrinform.

latvia.title: Ukraina droonid andsid õhulöögi Moskva lähedal asuvale naftarajatisele
latvia.description: Ukraina droonid võtsid ööl vastu teisipäeva korraldatud massilise õhurünnaku käigus sihikule suure naftarajatise Moskva oblastis, teatasid seirekanalid, mida vahendas ajaleht Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Ukraina droonid andsid ulatusliku õhulöögi Moskva oblastile
latvia.description: Ukraina droonid ründasid ööl vastu teisipäeva massiliselt Moskva oblastit, mille peale asus tööle piirkonna õhutõrje, teatasid seirekanalid, mida vahendas ajaleht Kyiv Independent.

latvia.title: Ukraina kasutab Vene droonide allatulistamiseks edukalt Türgi õhutõrjesüsteeme
latvia.description: Ukraina otsib aktiivselt õhutõrjesüsteeme, et kaitsta riiki Venemaa õhurünnakute eest ja selleks osteti Türgist väike arv õhutõrjesüsteeme Korkut, mis osutused edukaks, teatas esmaspäeval meediakanal Middle East Eye oma allikatele viidates.

latvia.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1686. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Rubio: USA ei too Venemaa ähvarduste pärast diplomaate Kiievist ära
latvia.description: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1686. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis.2026/ukraina-kalender

latvia.title: KÄSIPAGASIGA SÕTTA ⟩ Eesti suursaadik Ukrainas: «Osa ajust kogu aeg kuulab, et ega õhuhäiret ei ole»
latvia.description: Ukrainas tahavad kõik lasteaialapsed saada sõduriks, ütleb Tiina Intelmann, Eesti uus suursaadik Ukrainas. Kiievisse, keset langevaid rakette, suundus ta suve lõpus, ja nagu palju kordi varemgi, üksi ja sisuliselt käsipagasiga.

latvia.title: FT: Venemaa tuumarelvad ei hirmuta enam NATO sõjalist liitu
latvia.description: Venemaa tuumaähvardustel on lääne otsustele üha vähem mõju ning Kremli võimekus kasutada oma tuumaarsenali heidutusena nõrgeneb järk-järgult, kirjutas esmaspäeval väljaanne Financial Times (FT), mida vahendas ukrainlaste uudisteagentuur Unian.

latvia.title: Techritory 2026 will focus on security threats
latvia.description: Policymakers and industry figures will meet on stage and off to discuss the greatest threats to European security, sovereignty, and resilience at Techritory 2026 – plus, presumably, how to do deals and make money.

latvia.title: airBaltic getting ready for mass layoffs
latvia.description: Between 500 and 700 jobs at its bases in Rīga, Vilnius and Tallinn – this is the number of staff who are likely to be laid off as a result of the implementation of Latvian national airline airBaltic’s new business plan, the company said in a news release.

latvia.title: Conference in Rīga to explore culture/health crossover
latvia.description: An upcoming international conference in Rīga will explore how to strengthen cooperation between the cultural and health sectors in education, its organizers have annnounced.

latvia.title: More than half of teachers are over 50 years old in the Baltics
latvia.description: October 5th is marked as World Teachers’ Day, and to celebrate the occasion, Eurostat released some data on teachers in the European Union.

latvia.title: Chestnut collector's coin to be issued in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, 8 October, Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) will issue "Chestnut", a silver collector coin with gilded details, symbolically depicting one of the heralds of autumn.

latvia.title: People smuggler, five illegal border crossers caught in eastern Latvia
latvia.description: On Saturday, October 3rd, in Krāslava municipality, border guards—in cooperation with soldiers from the National Armed Forces—detained a Latvian citizen who was transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border, according to a State Border Guard release.

latvia.title: President Rinkēvičs wishes 'warmth and kindness' to teachers
latvia.description: President Edgars Rinkēvičs’ office has published a text called 'Greeting on Teachers’ Day' on October 5th. Here it is.

latvia.title: Rather gloomy weather week in Latvia
latvia.description: At the start of the new working week, the summery weather will give way to cooler conditions, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: Which politicians will fill the chamber of the 15th Saeima?
latvia.description: Which 100 politicians will represent the interests of voters and decide about our lives in the future? LSM.lv has estimated that the following candidates for deputies could be elected to the 15th Saeima.

latvia.title: Bridge over the Lielupe to be closed at night
latvia.description: The construction season is continuing on the national road network, with work taking place on 58 sections. From 7:50 pm on Monday 5 October until 5:50 am on 6 October, the bridge over the Lielupe River on the Liepāja highway will be closed to traffic, according to Latvian State Roads (LVC).

latvia.title: Postal votes also counted as of Monday morning in Latvia
latvia.description: The Central Election Commission (CVK) has compiled the provisional results of the 15th Saeima elections held on 3 October – including votes cast by post. According to the provisional data compiled, 806,641 voters, or 51.79 per cent of those eligible to vote, took part in the election.

latvia.title: 'Amber Latvijas balzams' moves some production to Lithuania
latvia.description: Amber Latvijas balzams, which is currently facing financial difficulties, must draw up a legal protection plan and agree it with its creditors by Monday, October 5. This plan protects the creditors’ interests and would allow the company to continue operating. Meanwhile, the company itself is optimising its costs and is already manufacturing some of its products in Lithuania, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Many voters said yes to United List, no to its candidates
latvia.description: When you vote in Latvian elections, you not only select a party, but you have the option to mark 'for' or 'against' specific candidates to move them 'up' or 'down' their respective list. PM Andris Kulbergs (United List) received the most upvotes in the 15th Saeima elections, but the 'most downvoted' list is also nearly exclusively made up of his party members, Latvian Television reported on October 5.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: The votes are in: United List handed massive mandate by Latvian voters
latvia.description: With 99.9% of the votes counted in Latvia's 2026 Saeima election, the shape of Latvia's political future for the next four years is now clear: it's tall, bald and named Andris Kulbergs.

latvia.title: Ten key takeouts from Latvia's election results
latvia.description: Here is a quick diagnosis of some of the main implications of Latvia's election result for the benefit of foreign observers who might not be familiar with the ins and outs of Latvian politics. There is some speculation and deduction involved, but that's all part of the fun.

latvia.title: Many changed their vote in this year's Saeima elections
latvia.description: The number of voters who changed their vote in the 15th Saeima elections has increased nearly sevenfold, said Māris Zviedris, head of the Central Election Commission (CVK), in an interview on Latvian Television on Sunday morning, when approximately 95 per cent of the votes had been counted.

latvia.title: New Latvian Saeima starts to shape up with nearly all votes counted
latvia.description: At 7:30 AM on Sunday, October 4, the vast majority of polling stations had counted all their votes, and according to these data, six candidate lists have an opportunity to make it into the 15th Saeima.

latvia.title: United List holds dominant position as votes continue to be counted
latvia.description: With 58% of polling stations having sent their voting results to the Central Election Commission, the United List political force of Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs holds a strong lead over its rivals in the early hours of Sunday, October 4th as votes continue to be counted.

latvia.title: Voter turnout looks like a new low in Latvian parliamentary history
latvia.description: Slightly more than half of the voters eligible to vote in Latvia's parliamentary election on October 3rd appear to have bothered to exercise their democratic right, raising serious questions about political engagement, media coverage and perhaps even whether people still value democracy as they did a generation ago.

latvia.title: How does the vote count happen in Latvia's election?
latvia.description: While the votes are being counted in Latvia's 2026 election, let's take a moment to consider how it all happens. This information comes from the Central Election Commission (CVK), which is responsible for organizing and administering all public elections in Latvia.

latvia.title: Exit poll: Kulbergs and United List on track to be top dogs in Latvian election
latvia.description: With the close of polling stations across Latvia at 20:00 on Saturday, October 3rd, the exit poll produced by SKDS has been made available.

latvia.title: Police have gone out to 20 election-related calls on Saturday
latvia.description: On Saturday, October 3, the State Police, responded to 20 separate reports of possible breaches regarding the Saeima elections, of which administrative proceedings were initiated in four cases, the State Police reported.

latvia.title: Latvia continues voting in 15th Saeima elections
latvia.description: Latvians go to the polls on Saturday, October 3rd for the 15th Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Better performance from Latvia's footballers, but another loss
latvia.description: The UEFA Nations League marathon continues, in which the Latvian national team finally opened its scoring account in its third game, but suffered a loss to Montenegro 1:2.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvian party leaders' final pre-election debate
latvia.description: A highlight of the four-year political calendar in Latvia takes place on Friday night with the final pre-election showdown between the leaders of the 14 political forces contending Saturday's election.

latvia.title: It is election day in Latvia
latvia.description: The 15th Saeima elections are taking place in Latvia on Saturday, 3 October. Polling stations for voters in Latvia and abroad are open from 8:00 to 20:00 local time.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Montenegro Nations League international football
latvia.description: Latvia's football team is in action again on Friday night with a Nations League clash in Rīga against Montenegro.

latvia.title: Early voting turnout in Latvia surpasses 10% on Friday
latvia.description: More than 10% of Latvia's electorate has taken advantage of the opportunity to cast a vote before the main election day on October 3rd.

latvia.title: Latvia still lags on breast cancer screening
latvia.description: Breast cancer is one of the most common forms of cancer in the EU, and screening and other preventive measures are essential to lowering the impact of the disease and reducing mortality rates. Fresh data released by Eurostat on October 2nd to mark the beginning of Breast Cancer Awareness Month show that Latvia's screening rates remain behind most other EU countries.

latvia.title: Latvian human rights expert re-elected to UN position
latvia.description: On 1st October 2026, in Geneva, Latvian human rights expert Dr Elīna Šteinerte was re-elected to the United Nations' Subcommittee on Prevention of Torture (SPT) under the Optional Protocol to the Convention Against Torture (OPCAT) for the 2027–2030 term.

latvia.title: Who to choose in dangerous times?
latvia.description: A year and a half ago, when weighing the arguments for running for the position of Editor-in Chief of Latvian Public Media (LSM), I had to ask myself whether I would be capable of leading the creation of public media content during wartime.

latvia.title: Final day of advance voting in Latvia
latvia.description: On Friday, 2 October, the very last day before the 15th Saeima elections, you can cast your vote in advance. You can do this at any polling station throughout Latvia between 12 noon and 3 pm.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Birds, Mushrooms, Fire
latvia.description: What to do after you've voted? Go out in nature! Here are some events for birdwatchers, fungus fans and fire fanatics.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank issues another crypto licence to German-owned company
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka (LB) is issuing a licence to a company called Atrya Technologies SIA for the provision of crypto-asset services, the central bank said on October 1st.

latvia.title: Latvia not liable in care home detention case
latvia.description: The European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) published a decision on October 1st concerning a case brought by a resident of a Latvian care home who claimed he had been wrongfully detained by police officers.

latvia.title: Progressives' party member expelled over nature of relations with minor
latvia.description: The Progressives party has reported former party member Mārtiņš Eņģelis to the police over alleged sexual relations with a minor, newswire LETA reports.

latvia.title: Latvian government desperately tries to cut Rail Baltica costs
latvia.description: The cost per kilometre of the European standard-gauge railway will be up to 20 million euros, the government decided at a closed-door emergency government meeting on October 1, at which an informative report on the “Rail Baltica” railway project was considered. Until now, the cost per kilometre had been as high as 32 million euros.

latvia.title: Summery Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia on Friday will be mainly sunny and warm.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 1st October, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Two charged over rape of minor in Vidzeme region
latvia.description: Two people are being charged in the disturbing case of a 12-year-old girl who was raped in Vidzeme region – a man who had sexual relations with the girl, resulting in her becoming pregnant, and a woman who knew about the incident and did not report it to law enforcement.

latvia.title: Reduction of fuel prices as of Thursday in Latvia
latvia.description: Across Latvia, fuel will become a bit cheaper from Thursday, 1 October. It is expected that the price of fuel could fall by around eight cents per litre. Residents in eastern Latvia have pointed out that the price reduction is too small, LSM's Latgale editorial reports.

latvia.title: More births than deaths among Latvian businesses
latvia.description: New data published by Eurostat show that in 2024 Latvia saw far more businesses opening up than closing down.

latvia.title: Latvian central bank mediates in 'Warren Buffett' bank account case
latvia.description: Latvijas Banka, the Latvian central bank (LB) and financial regulator has said it is launching a mediation process regarding difficulties experienced by "Mitek Industries", a Swedish company with links to renowned billionaire investor Warren Buffett, in its efforts to open a bank account for its spun-off Latvian subsidiary.

latvia.title: At least 110 thousand have voted in advance in Saeima elections
latvia.description: During the first four days, at least 110,000 people took the opportunity to cast their votes in advance of the 15th Saeima elections, and a further 5,000 citizens have applied to vote by post, which the Central Election Commission also counts towards voter turnout, bringing the total to 7.44 per cent.

latvia.title: Saeima rules that LSM can write in Russian only on specific occasions
latvia.description: On Latvian Public Media (LSM), content in Russian will only be permitted in exceptional circumstances, in the event of a state of emergency, or for the specific purpose of countering disinformation. This was decided by the Saeima on Thursday, 1 October.

lithuania.description: OpenAI boss Sam Altman and Anthropic chief Dario Amodei warn of the risks of overly rapid AI development. More experts now think AI could wipe out humanity. How realistic is that? Euronews talks to AI specialist Reinhard Karger.

lithuania.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, Brazilian senator, presidential hopeful and son to embattled former leader Jair, says he is “very happy” to have led in the first round and heading into the runoff, with incumbent Lula expressing disappointment over “unexpected” results.

lithuania.description: Agydaganatos betegeknek és hozzátartozóiknak szervezett betegedukációs napot a Semmelweis Egyetem alapítványa. Az ott elhangzott beszédem arról szólt, miért éri meg a betegségről beszélni, még akkor is, ha nehéz.

lithuania.title: Kiszivárgott a haditerv: így verné vissza a NATO az ellenséges támadást
lithuania.description: Új stratégiai dokumentumon dolgozik Alexus Grynkewich tábornok, a NATO európai erőinek legfelsőbb parancsnoka. A terv azt vázolja fel, miként érhetne el a szövetség gyors győzelmet a keleti szárnyát érő esetleges orosz támadás esetén - írta a Bloomberg .

lithuania.title: „Teória víťazstva“ NATO: Najvyšší veliteľ Aliancie Alexus Grynkewich odhalí stratégiu proti ruskej agresii
lithuania.description: Najvyšší veliteľ spojeneckých síl NATO v Európe Alexus Grynkewich predstaví budúci týždeň na bezpečnostnej konferencii vo Varšave svoju „teóriu víťazstva“. Stratégia má definovať jasný rámec na udržanie prevahy Aliancie, zastavenie prípadnej agresie a odrazenie ruského útoku.

lithuania.title: Americký generál dal plánu jednoduchý názov. Má ukázať, čo NATO urobí, ak Rusko zaútočí
lithuania.description: Najvyšší vojenský veliteľ NATO v Európe Alexus Grynkewich pripravuje odpoveď na jednu z najvážnejších otázok, aké dnes Aliancia rieši: čo presne urobiť, ak by Rusko zaútočilo na územie niektorého z jej členov. Americký generál ju nazval jednoducho – „Theory of Victory“, teda teória víťazstva.

lithuania.title: Kvóty pro Filipínce nestačí, stěžují si firmy. Jednají o jejich navýšení
lithuania.description: Obliba pracovníků z Filipín u českých firem vzrostla v posledních měsících letos natolik, že jim nestačí dosavadní státem vypsané kvóty. Měsíční limit pro nové příchozí pracovníky vyčerpaly v červenci poprvé od jeho navýšení před dvěma lety. Totéž se stalo i v srpnu a září. Podniky proto jednají s vládou o dalším zvýšení.

lithuania.title: Německu hrozí násilný konflikt s Ruskem, varoval šéf rozvědky BND
lithuania.description: Německu hrozí, že bude vtaženo do násilného konfliktu s Ruskem, a hrozba útoků na cíle v Německu zůstává reálná. Řekl to v pondělí šéf Spolkové zpravodajské služby (BND) Martin Jäger poslancům Spolkového sněmu. Právě Rusko v současnosti představuje pro Německo největší hrozbu, přičemž akce nízké intenzity namířené proti členským státům NATO už nejsou výjimkou, upozornil Jäger.

lithuania.title: Nobelovu cenu získali vědci za objevy umožňující ovládat buňky světlem
lithuania.description: Objev optogenetiky natolik posunul lidské poznání, že za něj jeho autoři dostali Nobelovu cenu za medicínu a fyziologii. Oznámil to v pondělí dopoledne Švédský Karolínský institut.

lithuania.title: „Teoria victoriei”. Un document NATO arată cum planifică alianța înfrângerea Rusiei în cazul unei confruntări directe
lithuania.description: Comandantul suprem al NATO în Europa pregătește o strategie pentru a respinge rapid un potențial atac rus asupra flancului estic al alianței. Proiectul de plan ar urma să utilizeze forțe terestre alături de drone, sisteme cu echipaj redus și inteligență artificială pentru a opri o incursiune și a distruge structurile de comandă inamice, potrivit unui document intitulat „Teoria victoriei”.

lithuania.title: Lituania avertizează că un milion de refugiați ar putea fugi în Polonia în cazul unui atac al Rusiei
lithuania.description: Lituania a declarat că până la un milion de persoane ar putea căuta refugiu în Polonia în cazul unui atac al Moscovei asupra statelor baltice, în timp ce cei doi aliați NATO lucrează la planuri pentru o eventuală evacuare în masă, scrie TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Scandal în fața DIICOT la audierea socrului lui Georgescu. Bărbatul care a lovit doi jurnaliști cu „un obiect metalic” a fost reținut
lithuania.description: Socrul lui Călin Georgescu a fost audiat aproximativ cinci ore la DIICOT, unde procurorii au făcut verificări asupra dispozitivelor sale electronice. La ieșirea de la audieri, unul dintre susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu ar fi provocat o altercație cu jurnaliștii. Poliția a confirmat că doi jurnaliști au fost loviți cu „un obiect metalic”, iar presupusul agresor, un bărbat de 50 de ani, a fost dus la audieri și s-a deschis un dosar penal.

lithuania.title: Cine este Luca Niculescu, a patra nominalizare a lui Nicușor Dan pentru funcția de prim-ministru
lithuania.description: Luca Niculescu este noua nominalizare a președintelui Nicușor Dan pentru postul de premier al României. Luca Niculescu a fost numit Secretar de Stat în cadrul Ministerul Afacerilor Externe și Coordonator Național pentru procesul de aderare a României la OCDE în 2022. Un diplomat format pe băncile Universității București, la Facultatea de Jurnalism și Științele Comunicării, el nu are afiliere politică, dar are o bogată activitate ca jurnalist și, de altfel, a și primit distincții pentru aceasta.

lithuania.title: Dan Dungaciu, după consultările cu Nicușor Dan: „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj. Soluția pentru noi sunt alegerile anticipate”
lithuania.description: AUR susține că actuala criză politică nu poate fi rezolvată prin consultările de la Cotroceni și indică alegerile anticipate drept soluție. După întâlnirea cu Nicușor Dan, Dan Dungaciu a acuzat Președinția că ignoră „spiritul și litera Constituției” și a spus că „Cotroceniul este un factor de blocaj”. La rândul său, liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, afirmă că există o majoritate pentru anticipate și susține că i-a cerut șefului statului să oprească ceea ce el numește „degradarea instituției prezidențiale”.

lithuania.title: Aproape 100 de amenzi la protestele susținătorilor lui Călin Georgescu de la Arestul Central. Au fost întocmite patru sesizări penale
lithuania.description: Jandarmii au aplicat aproape o sută de amenzi în zona Arestului Central din București, unde s-au strâns susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu încă din momentul în care acesta a fost arestat preventiv pentru înșelăciune. De asemenea, au fost întocmite actele pentru patru sesizări penale.

lithuania.title: Mesajul lui Nicușor Dan după ce susținătorii lui Călin Georgescu i-au cântat „veșnica pomenire” lui Cristian Tudor Popescu
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan consideră „inacceptabile” atacurile la adresa jurnalistului Cristian Tudor Popescu şi orice încercare de a transforma un dezacord politic într-un instrument de intimidare.

lithuania.title: Strategie de „apărare activă”: un stat baltic își mută trupele mai aproape de granița cu Rusia. „Obiectivul nostru este clar”
lithuania.description: Estonia își mută trupele în mod permanent mai aproape de granița cu Rusia și achiziționează armament capabil să lovească adânc în teritoriul vecinului său, în contextul în care această țară situată pe linia frontului NATO se pregătește pentru o eventuală agresiune rusă dincolo de granițele Ucrainei, potrivit unor oficiali, relatează Financial Times.

lithuania.title: Cine sunt oamenii care dorm doar 4-5 ore pe noapte și nu simt oboseala: misterele geneticii somnului scurt natural
lithuania.description: Definiția lui Brad Johnson pentru un somn bun diferă de cea a majorității. Cinci ore îl lasă ager și energizat. Chiar și după o călătorie de 24 de ore în Europa, bărbatul în vârstă de 70 de ani din Providence, Utah, poate dormi șase ore timp de câteva nopți - dar niciodată cele șapte ore sau mai multe recomandate pentru adulți, scrie National Geographic.

lithuania.title: Ce se întâmplă dacă consumi alimente bogate în zahăr pe durata tratamentului cu antibiotice. Descoperirea făcută de un nou studiu
lithuania.description: Evitarea alimentelor şi băuturilor îndulcite cu zahăr pe parcursul tratamentului cu antibiotice poate proteja microflora intestinală şi, prin urmare, sănătatea generală a pacientului, conform unui studiu clinic publicat în revista Nature şi citat de agenţia de presă EFE.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu, înainte de consultări: Nicușor Dan are o abordare infantilă. O să-i spunem singura soluție la blocajul politic
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a declarat duminică seară, la Digi24, că președintele Nicușor Dan are o abordare infantilă în ce privește criza politică, pecizând că luni, la consultările de la Palatul Cotroceni, îi va spune acestuia care e singura soluție pentru a depăși blocajul: organizarea alegerilor anticipate.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu îl ironizează pe Nicușor Dan înainte de consultările de la Cotroceni. Ce melodie i-a dedicat președintelui
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a postat duminică o melodie pe Facebook și un mesaj ironic referitor la consultările de luni cu președintele Nicușor Dan, de la Palatul Cotroceni.

lithuania.description: Activitatea hibridă tot mai intensă a Rusiei în Svalbard stârnește temeri că Moscova ar putea provoca un incident care să pună la încercare clauza de apărare reciprocă prevăzută la articolul 5 al NATO, scrie Politico.

lithuania.description: Un susținător al lui Călin Georgescu acuzat că a agresat doi cameramani în faţa sediului DIICOT din București, luni, a fost reţinut pentru 24 de ore şi va fi prezentat magistraţilor cu propunerea unei măsuri preventive. „Cercetările sunt continuate sub aspectul săvârşirii infracţiunilor de lovire sau alte violenţe, ameninţare şi tulburarea ordinii şi liniştii publice, …

lithuania.description: Russia's escalating attacks on Ukraine and threats against the West are signs of its failure to achieve a breakthrough on the battlefield, former ambassador to NATO Jüri Luik tells ERR in an interview.

lithuania.description: Ukraina droonid ründasid ööl vastu teisipäeva massiliselt Moskva oblastit, mille peale asus tööle piirkonna õhutõrje, teatasid seirekanalid, mida vahendas ajaleht Kyiv Independent.

lithuania.description: Ukraina otsib aktiivselt õhutõrjesüsteeme, et kaitsta riiki Venemaa õhurünnakute eest ja selleks osteti Türgist väike arv õhutõrjesüsteeme Korkut, mis osutused edukaks, teatas esmaspäeval meediakanal Middle East Eye oma allikatele viidates.

lithuania.title: 'Amber Latvijas balzams' moves some production to Lithuania
lithuania.description: Amber Latvijas balzams, which is currently facing financial difficulties, must draw up a legal protection plan and agree it with its creditors by Monday, October 5. This plan protects the creditors’ interests and would allow the company to continue operating. Meanwhile, the company itself is optimising its costs and is already manufacturing some of its products in Lithuania, Latvian Radio reports.
